column1: Venus rotates once every 243 Earth days and completes one orbit around the Sun in 225 Earth days.
The mythical unicorn is Scotland's official national animal.
The Great Wall is not visible from the Moon and is difficult or impossible to distinguish with the unaided eye even from low Earth orbit.
The octopus has three hearts. Two move oxygen-depleted blood through the gills, while the third circulates oxygenated blood through the body. Its copper-based blood appears blue.
A cow has one stomach with four interconnected compartments: the rumen, reticulum, omasum, and abomasum.
The Eiffel Tower contracts in cold weather, but the tower loses only a few millimetres in height, not fifteen metres.
Possible shark-ancestor scales date to about 450 million years ago, and sharks appeared in the fossil record before trees existed.
Big Ben is the nickname of the Great Bell of the Westminster clock tower, although the name is commonly used for the whole landmark.
